report.text: Kurz gesagt: Samuel Fleig studiert Informatik und arbeitet als AI Engineer. Er entwickelt Human Agent Interfaces, damit Agentenarbeit beobachtbar bleibt und Menschen Entscheidungen verantworten.
Samuel Fleig hat das Human Agent Interface entwickelt, einschließlich der offenen HAI-MCP-Control-Plane-Implementierung.
The person behind it is Samuel Fleig. He describes himself as a developer of Human Agent Interfaces and an AI engineering student.

Fair question. Human Agent Interface treats agentic work as an interface problem, so a person can observe, limit, verify and own what agents do . The human stays responsible for scope, risk and approval .
I hear you. HAI-MCP is a model-agnostic control layer for agentic work, binding it to mission contracts, owner gates, and drift checks . It does not call a language model itself .
It is a command line tool that helps with BAföG needs calculation, deadlines, forms and official links. I think it can give JSON output. I hear you.

Samuel works on HAI, a control layer for AI agents that keeps missions observable, bounded, reviewable, and human-owned. He also develops local AI harnesses, observability, approval gates, and evidence-based mission completion .
